about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER

The supporter upgrade does not include Episode 6 "Summer Showdown".

OVERVIEW

Enjoy even more of the College Kings 2 – Episode 6 experience with the Supporter Upgrade!

This special Supporter Upgrade is for superfans of College Kings who want to help support development of College Kings and other projects from the mind of UndergradSteve.

This Supporter Upgrade contains the following goodies created with love by UndergradSteve and the College Kings Development Team:

1. SVC YEARBOOK

Now that your Freshman year is coming to a close, the official SVC Yearbook has been released on campus for students! Inside you can find pictures and information about all the characters you’ve come to love over the years! Your version of the Yearbook is particularly special, as it seems like Riley has gotten her hands on your copy and made some additional entries to give it that little extra personal touch that makes it yours.

2. CHLOE'S DIARY

Remember that time you saw Chloe’s Diary? If you’re a die-hard Chloe fan, or just kinda nosey, you were probably curious about what was in there! Luckily for you, she left it out in the open for anyone to find, and now it’s made its way into the Supporter Upgrade! Check it out and see the inner workings of her mind, maybe she has some thoughts on you?

3. RENDERS

We love our community and it’s their enthusiasm and passion that keeps us going and encourages us to do extra pieces of content like this. So please enjoy a selection of more than 70 gorgeous renders we’ve made in collaboration with our fans featuring some of the most popular girls as voted by the community!

TO ACCESS THIS EXCLUSIVE CONTENT

From the CK2 Main Menu, click the "Supporter Edition" icon to access the content.

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of various sexual acts and full frontal male and female nudity.
